name: Piercing Rays
primary:
Five thin white rays fire one after another from a ring around you toward your aim, up to 40 blocks. Each ray pierces every creature on its path:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ arcane per ray, up to 7.5 ❤ in total
self_description:
Defensive magic. On you:
• Stone skin (resistance II), 10 s
